title: Run and retain independent host corpus checks in ready CI
problem: Focused regressions alone do not exercise the independently compiled output corpus and framed memory comparison in hosted CI.
design: Add one explicit differential step to each Linux compiler/optimization job and upload its complete evidence directory even after a failure.
tradeoffs: This increases hosted compile work; cases sample behavior rather than prove full fmt compatibility. The separate runner does not inherit Make sanitizer flags. Draft compiler jobs remain skipped.

validation.results: Pending independent review and assembled portable validation.
validation.limitations: Portable validation runs on the complete feature commit. Hosted checks start only for ready review waves; draft skips and cancellations are not passing evidence. This does not repeat hardware campaigns.

source_changes: Build integration and documentation only; no formatter implementation changes.
